info.name: List of pipeline status

params.name: fqn
params.description: Fully qualified name of the ingestion pipeline

params.name: startTs
params.description: Filter pipeline status after the given start timestamp

params.name: endTs
params.description: Filter pipeline status before the given end timestamp

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of pipeline statuses to return

items.docs: Get a list of pipeline statuses for the given ingestion pipeline id. Optionally filter by `startTs` and `endTs`. When no time range is provided, the latest 5 runs are returned by default. Use cursor-based pagination to limit the number of entries in the list using `limit` and `before` or `after` query params.
